description: This file declares the interface for the IServerManagerModuleServiceFactory class, which is a factory class responsible for creating instances of ServerManagerModule and the factory itself within the Rialto server IPC component. It includes method declarations, class documentation, and external dependencies relevant to the factory pattern implementation.

classes.name: IServerManagerModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: A factory class that provides methods to create instances of ServerManagerModule and the factory itself for the Rialto server IPC.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Static method that creates and returns a shared pointer to an IServerManagerModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Pure virtual method that creates and returns a shared pointer to a ServerManagerModule, given a reference to ISessionServerManager.
